blurb: facemash for bluesky: two profiles side by side with their latest posts, click the one you like more. nominate any account — open to everyone, not gated by a cluster-score threshold anymore. rankings are pure elo from head-to-head votes, all stored as your own atproto records. built off a spec fromthewestmeadow.com linked from gideon-goddard.github.io.
